> Lightweight schema engine for TiddlyWiki — one tiddler per type, namespaced, hand-rolled UI

Define a type's fields, constraints, title formula, and namespace memberships all on a single tiddler. Spawn, edit, view, and validate typed instances through hand-rolled UIs with zero plugin dependencies.

## Key features

* **One tiddler per type** -- the type's full schema lives in fields and a JSON-encoded `kind.fields` array on a single tiddler. Body stays free for prose documentation.
* **Namespaces** -- types declare `kind.namespaces` (multi-membership). A namespace switcher restricts what's visible to the active scope.
* **Auto-computed titles** -- types declare a `kind.title-formula` filter; new instances get their title computed from sibling fields (e.g. `parent/abbrev`).
* **Live validation + bulk validator** -- inline errors as you edit; wiki-wide scan report on the validator tab.
* **Typeahead refs** -- filterable search input + filtered dropdown + selected pills with × remove; scales to large option sets.
* **Configurable stream-river view** -- each type chooses which fields appear in its in-river field bar; empty = bar hidden.
* **Hand-rolled UI** -- zero dependency on other rimir plugins (theme/components/typed). Optional soft dependency on doc-template for the branded documentation hub.

## Prerequisites

No external prerequisites. Optional: `rimir/doc-template` for the documentation hub.

## Quick start

1. Open the **type-builder** tab and define a new type (key, caption, icon, namespaces, title-formula, fields).
2. Open the **creator** tab, pick the type, fill the fields, click Create.
3. Open the resulting tiddler in the story river — the stream-view field bar appears at the top.
4. Use the **validator** tab for a wiki-wide constraint scan.

## Plugin Library

This plugin is part of the [rimir-cc tw-plugin-library](https://rimir-cc.github.io/tw-plugin-library/).

|!Version |!Date |!Changes |
|v0.1.51 |2026-05-29 |''Fix: ref field with no `ref-types` now lists all kind-instances instead of every tiddler in the wiki.'' Two coupled bugs. ''(1) `kind.ref-types` was returning one empty string'' whenever the field had no `ref-types` JSON property (the common "any kind" case the type-builder already advertised via `(any kind)`). Root cause is a TW core quirk in `:map:flat` — when the subfilter returns empty for a given iteration item, `core/modules/filterrunprefixes/map.js:32-34` falls through to `results.push(filtered[0]||"")`, pushing a literal empty string instead of pushing nothing. `kind.ref-types`'s outer `:map:flat[function[kind.field-array-flat],…,[ref-types]]` iterates over the one field-index, the inner `kind.field-array-flat` returns empty when the `ref-types` JSON path doesn't exist, and the empty-string fallback kicks in. The empty string then feeds into `kind.ref-candidates`'s `kind.type<currentTiddler>` subfilter as `kind.type[]` — TW's field operator (`core/modules/filters/field.js:62`) treats a missing field's value as `""`, so `tiddler.getFieldString("kind.type") === ""` matches ''every tiddler that exists in the source''. With `all[shadows+tiddlers]` as the source, the dropdown filled with the entire wiki (minus type-definitions, since `!has[kind.fields]` still filtered those out). Fixed with `+[!is[blank]]` appended to `kind.ref-types` — strips the spurious empty so callers see a genuinely-empty list when ref-types is unset. ''(2) `kind.ref-candidates` now honours the type-builder's documented `(any kind)` semantics.'' Previously, an empty `kind.ref-types` produced no candidates AT ALL (the `:map:flat` over an empty list short-circuits) — so even with the (1) fix, the picker would have rendered "no matches" instead of the intended "any kind-instance is a valid target". Split into three: new helper `kind.ref-candidates-typed(type-tid, field-key)` for the original "instances of each configured ref-type" path (kept structurally identical to the old body), new helper `kind.ref-candidates-any(type-tid, field-key)` for the fallback — `[function[kind.ref-types],…count[]match[0]] :map:flat[all[shadows+tiddlers]has[kind.type]!has[kind.fields]]` fires only when ref-types is genuinely empty, mapping the synthetic "0" sentinel to all kind-instances in the wiki. Combined `kind.ref-candidates` unions both helpers + `+[unique[]]`. Two runs (vs. a `~` else-fallback) so the "ref-types set but no instances exist yet" case stays correctly empty — `~` would have over-triggered there. ''Why split instead of inline:'' the two branches are independent and want distinct sources; `:map:flat` operating on the accumulator makes inline composition fragile (re-mapping accumulator items into a flat-map subfilter would be wrong). |v0.1.10 |2026-05-25 |''+ Add field from library: common-fields picker in Manage-kinds.'' New leaf ''+ Add field from library…'' (📚, order 700, grouped under fields) sits at the bottom of the per-kind field list. Drilling lists every common-field tiddler tagged `$:/tags/rimir/kind/common-field` ''that isn't already on this kind'' (uses `kind.is-common-field-unused` — same filter the type-builder's library dropdown uses). Each common-field row shows ''`<key> · <typed>`'' + the field's icon. Picking one appends its `def` JSON to `kind.fields` at the next index AND appends its key to `kind.stream-fields`, then `ca-after-fire: pop`s back to the kind-edit stage so the new field row appears immediately. ''Action wiring:'' since the per-CF leaf needs to read the picked CF's `def` field and the kind's current `kind.fields` length at fire time, the action wikitext can't be a single short `$action-setfield` — it needs `<$let>` to compute next-idx + cf-def + cf-key first. The leaf's `ca-actions` therefore calls a new `\procedure kind.cascade-add-cf-to-kind(target-tid, cf-tid)` via `<$transclude $variable="…" target-tid="…" cf-tid="…"/>` with both tids baked in at item-build time. The procedure body is the existing type-builder's add-common-field logic (the `jsonset:json<idx>,<cf-def>` + `+[append<cf-key>]` listops pair) wrapped in a `<$let>`. `invokeViaNavigator` renders the action tree before invokeActions so the transcluded procedure's action widgets fire normally. ''New helpers:'' `kind.cascade-add-from-library-row` (the "+" leaf), `kind.cascade-add-from-library-items` (picker items-from), `kind.cascade-cf-leaf-build` + three sub-helpers (`-with-key`, `-with-typed`, `-with-icon`) that thread cf-key / cf-typed / cf-icon through the chain, and the `kind.cascade-add-cf-to-kind` procedure. Tiddler-only — no restart. |
|v0.1.9 |2026-05-25 |''Typed + cardinality as drill-pickers.'' The 0.1.8 field-edit stage forced the user to type `enum` / `ref` / `$calculated` / `single` / `multi` correctly in a text input. Both are now proper drill-pickers. ''typed'' drill opens a 9-leaf picker (`text` / `longtext` / `number` / `date` / `datetime` / `enum` / `ref` / `$title` / `$calculated`); picking writes the chosen value to `kind.fields[<idx>],typed` via `<$action-setfield $tiddler=… kind.fields={{{ […jsonset[<idx>],[typed],[<value>]] }}}/>` and `ca-after-fire: pop`s back to the field-edit stage. ''cardinality'' drill (conditionally present per `kind.cardinality-applicable`) opens a 2-leaf picker (`single` / `multi`). Each picker drill row carries `ca-bind-tiddler`/`-field`/`-path` so cascade-palette's `_renderBoundDrillValue` surfaces the current value alongside the row — Space → drill → pick → return is the keyboard flow. ''Applicability is dynamic'' — changing typed from `ref` to `text` makes the cardinality row disappear on next render (cascade-palette refreshes the items-from on every tiddler change), matching the type-builder UI's "disabled when text" cell. ''New helpers:'' generic `kind.cascade-field-drill-row(kind-tid, field-idx, prop, caption, icon, order, picker-fn)` builds a drill row for any prop with a configurable picker function; `kind.cascade-jsonset-leaf-build(kind-tid, field-idx, prop, value)` builds a leaf that writes one JSON-path value (shared between typed and cardinality pickers); two picker-items functions `kind.cascade-field-typed-picker-items` and `kind.cascade-field-cardinality-picker-items` emit the static enum lists. ''Still deferred:'' common-fields library picker ("+ Add field from library") — needs procedure-as-action wiring (the per-CF leaf's actions need to read the picked CF's `def` field at fire time and append it to kind.fields, which is more wikitext than fits cleanly in a bake-time string-built ca-actions). Tiddler-only — no restart. |
|v0.1.8 |2026-05-25 |''Per-field property editing.'' Field rows in the Manage-kinds drill (the `<key> · <typed>` rows from 0.1.7) are now ''drill'' rows that open a per-field edit stage. The stage shows text-edit rows for ''typed'' / ''caption'' / ''icon'' (always present) and ''cardinality'' (conditionally present, only when typed is `enum` or `ref` — uses the existing `kind.cardinality-applicable` helper that the type-builder UI already uses to disable that cell for text-typed fields). Each row is `ca-kind: text` with `ca-bind-path: <field-idx>,<prop>` walking into the `kind.fields` JSON array — Space enters edit mode, Enter commits, value lands directly on the right JSON sub-path. A confirm-wrapped ''🗑 Delete this field'' leaf at the bottom calls the existing `kind.rebuilt-fields-without` helper (the same rebuild-by-filter used by the type-builder's delete-field button — `jsonset[N]` would corrupt the array to a sparse object per [[tw-gotchas-filters#jsonset on a JSON ARRAY converts it to an OBJECT]]). ''Same applicability rules the type-builder uses already work here'' because the cascade-mode reuses `kind.cardinality-applicable`. ''Deferred to next iteration:'' typed / cardinality as proper drill-pickers (currently plain text-edit — user has to type `enum` correctly); constraints / options / ref-types editing (string arrays need either string-array bind-type or sub-stage pickers); ''+ Add new field'' (needs the text-then-action wiring); common-fields library picker (drill into `$:/tags/rimir/kind/common-field` and copy the picked def into kind.fields). New helpers: `kind.cascade-field-edit-items`, `kind.cascade-field-prop-row`, `kind.cascade-field-cardinality-row`, `kind.cascade-field-delete-row`. Field rows now use `ca-kind: drill` instead of `ca-kind: leaf`. Tiddler-only — no restart. |
|v0.1.7 |2026-05-25 |''Fix: Manage-kinds metadata rows showed "(unset)" everywhere + added per-kind field-list rows.'' Two issues. ''(unset) everywhere:'' the metadata rows tried to bind via `<parent-picked>` to read each `kind.*` field, but cascade-palette's generic filter-drill does NOT propagate the picked title into the new stage's `parentPicked` — only entity-type / action-menu drills do (see cp-firing.js:489 vs :501). So `<parent-picked>` was empty, `ca-bind-tiddler` was empty, and every row's `_readBoundRaw` returned undefined → rendered as "(unset)". ''Fix:'' bake the kind-tid into the items-from filter string at row-build time (`"ca-items-from":"[function[kind.cascade-kind-edit-items],[<kind-tid>]]"`); the function now takes the kind-tid as an explicit parameter and threads it through every per-row helper. Same fix the existing instance-create flow already used (`kind.kind-find-build`, `kind.kind-create-build` etc.). ''Per-kind field list:'' user reported every kind showed the same 5 metadata rows even though the kinds differ (task has caption/abbrev/parent; project has just name; person is empty; etc.) — the kind.fields JSON array wasn't surfaced. Added a row per element of `kind.fields` (name = "`<key>` · `<typed>`", ordered first via `ca-order:<idx>`, grouped under "fields"), so drilling into "task" now shows three rows on top of the metadata rows: `caption · text`, `abbrev · text`, `parent · ref`. Field rows are currently leaves with no action (editing them per-property is the next iteration); they make the per-kind variation externally legible. New helpers: `kind.cascade-kind-field-rows`, `kind.cascade-field-row`, `kind.cascade-field-row-with-key`, `kind.cascade-field-row-build`. Metadata rows moved to order 500-540 (under "metadata" group), delete leaf at 900 (under "danger" group). Tiddler-only — no restart. |
|v0.1.6 |2026-05-25 |''Fix: Manage-kinds entry showed nothing.'' Hit the documented [[`\import` walker stops at first non-setvariable node|tw-gotchas-parser-pragma]] gotcha — `palette/cascade-helpers.tid` opened with `\import $:/plugins/rimir/kind/engine` followed by an HTML comment block, then the `\function` definitions. The cross-tiddler macro walker (which propagates setvariable defs to importers) stops at the first non-setvariable node it encounters; `\import` is non-setvariable, so every `\function` after it silently dropped from cascade-palette's view → the items-from filter resolved to nothing → empty drill. ''Fix:'' rewrote the file with all `\function` declarations consecutively at the top (engine's functions are already in scope via cascade-palette's startup-time `\import [tag[$:/tags/Macro]…]`, so the local `\import` of engine was redundant anyway); dropped all body-level HTML comments (they're also non-setvariable nodes — even with `\import` removed, comments interspersed between functions would have stopped the walker too). Now matches the existing `cascade-helpers.tid` layout. Tiddler-only — no restart. |
|v0.1.5 |2026-05-25 |''Cascade-palette: Manage kinds (edit existing type-defs).'' Picking a kind drills to a metadata-edit stage with five text-edit rows — one per flat `kind.*` field (`caption`, `icon`, `namespaces`, `title-formula`, `stream-fields`) — bound directly to the type-def tiddler. Each row uses cascade-palette's `ca-kind: text` so Space enters edit mode, Enter commits the new value to the type-def. A confirm-wrapped ''🗑 Delete this kind'' leaf at the bottom removes the type-def tiddler (instances unaffected). ''Files:'' new `palette/cascade-helpers.tid` (wikitext function library mirroring the existing cascade-helpers' addprefix/addsuffix JSON-emission pattern — `kind.cascade-manage-kinds-items`, `kind.cascade-manage-kind-row`, `kind.cascade-kind-edit-items`, `kind.cascade-meta-row`, `kind.cascade-delete-kind-row`) and `palette/entries/manage-kinds.tid` (the root entry). Editing the per-field `kind.fields` JSON array stays in the existing type-builder tab for now — follow-up will add cascade-mode field-list editing. Pure tiddler changes — no JS, no restart. |
|v0.1.4 |2026-05-21 |Ships ''`scopes/instances-of.tid`'' — a cascade-palette scope tiddler tagged ''`$:/tags/rimir/cascade-palette/scope`''. Adds the `,` prefix so the user can type `,<kind>` to restrict any cascade-palette result list to instances of that kind (e.g. `,node` filters to `[tag[node]]`). Argument is a kind tiddler title. Pure tiddler change — no JS, no restart. Requires cascade-palette ≥ 0.0.25 for the scope strip mechanism. |
|v0.1.3 |2026-05-21 |All three root entries (`Find entity`, `Find by kind`, `Create entity`) now carry `ca-group: Kind Actions` so they cluster under a shared header in the cascade-palette root menu (when grouping is enabled) instead of falling back to the auto-derived plugin name "kind". Tiddler-only change. |
|v0.1.2 |2026-05-21 |''Cascade integration — drill-fixing pass.'' (a) Fixed `kind.is-editable-field` — was `:filter[function[kind.is-computed-typed],…is[blank]]` which always evaluated to empty (`is[blank]` operates on titles, and is-computed-typed outputs `$title`/`$calculated` non-blank when matched), so every field was rejected as "not editable". Now uses `count[]match[0]` to keep fields where is-computed-typed produced zero rows. (b) `kind.save-leaf-build` rewritten — earlier version closed the JSON string with `\"}` (JSON-escaped quote = quote INSIDE the string, never closing it) AND emitted filter args as `"K","D"` (quoted strings are not a valid filter operand form). Now closes with `"}` and uses literal-bracket args `[K],[D]` (with brackets injected via the `_brackets` textref to dodge the parser's bracket counter). (d) `kind.cascade-fields-for-create` split so `:map:flat[field-edit-items]` runs ONLY over the draft-tid, not over the save-leaf JSON (previous version mapped both, producing one empty result + skipping the actual field edits). (e) Single-select picker leaves (`kind.enum-leaf-one`, `kind.ref-leaf-build`) now emit `ca-after-fire: pop` — cascade-palette fires the action, pops the picker stage, keeps the palette open on the create-fields stage. Three new root entries: `Find entity` (cross-type search by caption+title), `Find by kind` (drill kinds → instances), `Create entity` (in-palette draft + Save leaf). "},"$:/plugins/rimir/kind/creator":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/kind/creator","type":"text/vnd.tiddlywiki","text":"\whitespace trim
\import $:/plugins/rimir/kind/engine

! Create instance

<$let
  active-ns={{{ [function[kind.active-ns]] }}}
  state-type="$:/state/rimir/kind/creator/selected-type"
>

<div class="kind-ns-row">
<strong>Namespace:</strong> <code><$text text={{{ [<active-ns>!is[blank]] ~[[(all)]] }}}/></code>
<span style="opacity:0.6;font-size:0.85em;">(change in [[settings|$:/plugins/rimir/kind/settings]])</span>
</div>

<div class="kind-ns-row">
<strong>Type:</strong>
<span class="kind-pill-row">
<$list filter="[function[kind.types-all]] :filter[function[kind.belongs-to-ns],<active-ns>] +[sort[kind.type]]" variable="t">
<$button class={{{ [<state-type>get[text]match<t>then[kind-pill kind-pill-on]] ~[[kind-pill]] }}}>
<$action-setfield $tiddler=<<state-type>> text=<<t>>/>
<$transclude $variable="kind.apply-defaults-to" type-tid=<<t>> target-tid={{{ [<t>get[kind.type]addprefix[$:/state/rimir/kind/draft/]] }}}/>
<$text text={{{ [<t>get[kind.icon]] }}}/>
 <$text text={{{ [<t>get[kind.caption]!is[blank]] ~[<t>get[kind.type]] }}}/>
</$button>
</$list>
</span>
</div>

<$let type-tid={{{ [<state-type>get[text]] }}}>
<%if [<type-tid>!is[blank]] %>
<$let
  type-key={{{ [<type-tid>get[kind.type]] }}}
  target-tid={{{ [[$:/state/rimir/kind/draft/]addsuffix<type-key>] }}}
>

<$transclude $tiddler="$:/plugins/rimir/kind/editor"/>

<p>
<$button disabled={{{ [function[kind.any-invalid],<type-tid>,<type-key>,<target-tid>!is[blank]then[yes]] }}}>
<$action-createtiddler $basetitle={{{ [function[kind.eval-title],<type-tid>,<target-tid>] }}} $template=<<target-tid>> kind.type=<<type-key>>/>
<$action-deletetiddler $tiddler=<<target-tid>>/>
Create
</$button>
 
<$button tooltip="Discard the draft and re-seed it with the kind's field defaults — fresh entry starts pre-filled.">
<$action-deletetiddler $tiddler=<<target-tid>>/>
<$transclude $variable="kind.force-apply-defaults" type-tid=<<type-tid>> target-tid=<<target-tid>>/>
♻ Reset to defaults
</$button>
 
<span style="opacity:0.6;font-size:0.85em;">computed title: <code><$text text={{{ [function[kind.eval-title],<type-tid>,<target-tid>] }}}/></code></span>
</p>

</$let>
<%endif%>

"},"$:/plugins/rimir/kind/doc/architecture":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/kind/doc/architecture","rdt.order":"2","rdt.plugin-key":"kind","rdt.plugin-name":"kind","rdt.plugin-subtitle":"Lightweight schema engine — one tiddler per type, namespaced","rdt.section":"Architecture","type":"text/vnd.tiddlywiki","text":"<$transclude $tiddler="$:/plugins/rimir/doc-template/templates/page">
<$fill $name="body">

!! Schema model

|!Element |!Stored as |!Discovery |
|Type |One tiddler with fields `kind.type`, `kind.caption`, `kind.icon`, `kind.namespaces`, `kind.title-formula`, `kind.stream-fields`, `kind.fields` (JSON) |`[has[kind.type]has[kind.fields]]` |
|Field def |Entry inside the type's `kind.fields` JSON array |`[<type-tid>get[kind.fields]jsonindexes[]]` |
|Instance |Any tiddler with `kind.type: <type-key>` |`[kind.type<type-key>]` |

There are no separate per-field tiddlers, no inheritance slots, no enum tiddlers. The type tiddler is the single source of truth for its schema.

!! Namespace mechanism

* Each type's `kind.namespaces` field is a space-separated list of namespace tokens — a type can belong to many at once.
* The active namespace lives in `$:/config/rimir/kind/active-namespace` (single value; empty = all).
* All UI surfaces that enumerate types — //creator//, //overview//, //validator// — filter via the `kind.belongs-to-ns` function in `engine.tid`.

!! Field types (`typed` values)

|!`typed` |!Editor |!Storage |
|`text` |single-line `<$edit-text>` |plain string |
|`longtext` |textarea |plain string |
|`number` |numeric input |plain string |
|`date` |`<$edit-date>` |TW date format |
|`datetime` |`<$edit-date>` with time |TW datetime format |
|`url` |single-line `<$edit-text type="url">` |plain string; live format check requires `http://` or `https://` prefix |
|`email` |single-line `<$edit-text type="email">` |plain string; live format check `local@domain.tld` |
|`phone` |single-line `<$edit-text type="tel">` |plain string; live format check for German numbers (`+49` or `0` prefix) |
|`enum` |single: `<$select>`; multi: pill toggle row |single string or list-field |
|`ref` |typeahead (filter input + dropdown + selected pills with ×) |single tiddler title or list-field |
|`$title` |read-only |computed from `kind.title-formula` |
|`$calculated` |read-only |computed from the field's `formula` |

Extension point: `field-input.tid` is one `<%if [<typed>match[X]]%>` cascade. Adding a field type = one new branch.

!! Constraints

|!Constraint |!Meaning |
|`required` |Must have a value (blocking) |
|`min:N` |Min N characters (text/longtext/url/email/phone) or N entries (multi-enum / multi-ref) |
|`max:N` |Max N characters or entries |
|`unique` |Unique among instances of the same type |
|`unique:wiki` |Unique wiki-wide (across all tiddlers) |
|''(intrinsic)'' |`url` / `email` / `phone` fields carry a built-in format check that fires when the value is non-blank. See `kind.viol-format-url` / `-email` / `-phone` in `engine.tid`. Regex patterns live in `_patterns.tid`. |

The validator reports any violation as a row in its bulk report. The editor shows live error messages below each input.

Save gating: the in-tiddler creator's Create button is disabled when `kind.any-invalid` returns non-empty (the disabled expression appends `then[yes]` because TW's `$button` widget only treats the literal string `"yes"` as truthy). The cascade-palette flows (`+ New <kind>` and spawn `+ Create new <ref-kind>`) emit a Warning row in place of the Save leaf when `any-invalid` fires — same dispatch pattern as the title-empty Warning row. Warning rows carry `"ca-after-fire":"keep"` so Enter is a no-op (the palette stays open and the user can keep editing).

!! Title generation

When `kind.title-formula` is set, the creator computes a new instance's title by evaluating the formula against the draft state tiddler:

```
\function kind.eval-title(type-tid, target-tid)
  [<type-tid>get[kind.title-formula]]
  :map[<target-tid>subfilter<currentTiddler>]
```

Example formula: `[get[parent]][[/]][get[abbrev]]+[join[]]` produces `parent-title/abbrev` style titles.

!! Stream-view (ViewTemplate auto-registration)

`viewtemplate.tid` is tagged `$:/tags/ViewTemplate` with `list-after: $:/core/ui/ViewTemplate/title`. On any tiddler with a `kind.type` field, it renders `stream-view.tid`, which reads `kind.stream-fields` from the type and emits a compact bar. Empty/missing `kind.stream-fields` = bar renders nothing (self-disabling).

A click on a field cell opens a popup containing the field's editor; a top-bar toggle switches to inline-edit mode (the editor replaces the cell directly).

!! Shared infrastructure

* ''engine.tid'' — all shared functions: type discovery, namespace filtering, JSON field-array accessors, constraint extraction, validation predicates, display helpers (truncation, ref resolution), title-formula evaluation
* ''field-input.tid'' — typed-dispatch input widget used by editor, stream-view popup, stream-view inline, and type-builder live preview
* ''editor.tid'' — 2-column table editor; takes only `target-tid` in scope; transcludes field-input per row

</$fill>
</$transclude>
"},"$:/plugins/rimir/kind/doc/dev-workflow":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/kind/doc/dev-workflow","rdt.order":"3","rdt.plugin-key":"kind","rdt.plugin-name":"kind","rdt.plugin-subtitle":"Lightweight schema engine — one tiddler per type, namespaced","rdt.section":"Dev Workflow","type":"text/vnd.tiddlywiki","text":"<$transclude $tiddler="$:/plugins/rimir/doc-template/templates/page">
<$fill $name="body">

!! Plugin files

|!File |!Role |
|`engine.tid` |Shared functions (type discovery, JSON access, validation predicates, helpers) |
|`field-input.tid` |Per-field input dispatch (text/longtext/number/date/datetime/enum/ref/computed) |
|`editor.tid` |2-column form for editing one instance |
|`view.tid` |Read-only single-instance table view |
|`stream-view.tid` |Field bar for the stream river; popup/inline edit toggle |
|`viewtemplate.tid` |ViewTemplate hook that auto-renders stream-view on every `kind.type` instance |
|`creator.tid` |Type picker + editor + Create button (computes title) |
|`validator.tid` |Bulk wiki-wide constraint report |
|`overview.tid` |Card grid of types in the active namespace |
|`type-builder.tid` |Structured editor for type metadata + JSON textarea for fields |
|`settings.tid` |Namespace switcher + stream-bar truncation preference |
|`styles.tid` |All CSS, no rr-* dependency |

!! Restart rules

|!Change |!Restart needed? |
|Edit any `.tid` (engine, editor, creator, …) |No — filesystem-watcher syncs |
|Add a new type via type-builder |No — discovery is automatic |
|Add a new field type (extend `field-input.tid`) |No |
|Add a new constraint (extend `engine.tid` validation predicates) |No |

There are no JS modules in `v0.1.0`, so no restarts are required for any plugin edit.

!! Defining a new type

# Open the //type-builder// tab (`$:/plugins/rimir/kind/type-builder`).
# Use the ''Create blank type'' button, supplying a new title (e.g. `$:/myns/types/task`).
# Fill the metadata section: `kind.type` (key), `kind.caption`, `kind.icon`, `kind.namespaces`, `kind.title-formula`, `kind.stream-fields`.
# Edit the JSON in the //Field definitions// section. The //Parsed preview// table updates as you type; the //Live editor preview// shows what an instance editor will look like.
# Open the //creator// tab and try creating an instance.

!! Adding a new field type

# Open `field-input.tid`.
# Find the dispatch cascade (`<%elseif [<field-typed>match[X]]%>` chain).
# Add a new branch for your new `typed` value.
# (Optional) Update the //typed// reference table in `doc/architecture.tid`.

!! Adding a new constraint

# Open `engine.tid`.
# Add a `kind.viol-<name>(type-tid, field-key, target-tid)` filter function that returns non-empty when the constraint is violated.
# Add a corresponding `<%if [function[kind.viol-<name>]]%>` branch in `field-input.tid` (for live errors) and `validator.tid` (for bulk report).
# Extend `kind.viol-any` so the creator's disabled-button predicate covers the new constraint.

!! Known limitations (v0.1.0)

* The type-builder's field-list editor is a textarea (raw JSON); a fully-structured row-by-row editor with add/delete/reorder is planned for v0.2.
* Multi-value uniqueness is exact-string-equality, not set-equality. Two instances with assignees `"alice bob"` and `"bob alice"` are NOT considered duplicates.
* No referential integrity: deleting a tiddler that other instances reference does not clean up the references.
* No schema migration: changing a field's `typed` after instances exist may leave stale values.

</$fill>
</$transclude>
"},"$:/plugins/rimir/kind/doc/examples":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/kind/doc/examples","rdt.order":"4","rdt.plugin-key":"kind","rdt.plugin-name":"kind","rdt.plugin-subtitle":"Lightweight schema engine — one tiddler per type, namespaced","rdt.section":"Examples","type":"text/vnd.tiddlywiki","text":"<$transclude $tiddler="$:/plugins/rimir/doc-template/templates/page">
<$fill $name="body">

!! A task type (orga namespace)

Create a type tiddler with the following fields:

```
title: $:/orga/types/task
kind.type: task
kind.namespaces: orga
kind.caption: Task
kind.icon: 🧮
kind.title-formula: [get[parent]][[/]][get[abbrev]]+[join[]]
kind.stream-fields: status assignee due-date
kind.fields: [{"key":"abbrev","caption":"Abbreviation","icon":"🔜","typed":"text","constraints":["required","min:3","unique"]},{"key":"description","caption":"Description","typed":"longtext"},{"key":"parent","caption":"Parent","icon":"📁","typed":"ref","ref-types":["project","workstream"],"cardinality":"single"},{"key":"status","caption":"Status","icon":"🚦","typed":"enum","options":["open","doing","done"],"cardinality":"single","constraints":["required"]},{"key":"assignee","caption":"Assignee","icon":"👤","typed":"ref","ref-types":["person"],"cardinality":"multi"},{"key":"due-date","caption":"Due","icon":"📅","typed":"date"}]
```

After saving, the //creator// tab shows ''Task'' in its type dropdown (when the active namespace is ''orga'' or blank). Filling fields and clicking Create produces a tiddler titled `<parent>/<abbrev>` with `kind.type: task` and the field values written through.

!! A shared "note" type (orga and private namespaces)

A type can belong to multiple namespaces:

```
title: $:/shared/types/note
kind.type: note
kind.namespaces: orga private
kind.caption: Note
kind.icon: 📝
kind.title-formula: [[note-]] [get[topic]] +[join[]]
kind.stream-fields: topic created
kind.fields: [{"key":"topic","caption":"Topic","typed":"text","constraints":["required"]},{"key":"body","caption":"Body","typed":"longtext"}]
```

Switching the active namespace between ''orga'' and ''private'' (in //settings//) — this type appears in both.

!! Format-validated fields (url / email / phone)

A `person` type with contact fields demonstrates the three format-validated typed values:

```
title: $:/orga/types/person
kind.type: person
kind.namespaces: orga
kind.caption: Person
kind.icon: 👤
kind.stream-fields: email phone homepage
kind.fields: [{"key":"name","typed":"text","constraints":["required"]},{"key":"email","caption":"Email","icon":"📧","typed":"email","constraints":["required"]},{"key":"phone","caption":"Phone","icon":"📞","typed":"phone"},{"key":"homepage","caption":"Homepage","icon":"🔗","typed":"url"}]
```

Each format-validated field surfaces a live error in the editor and a row in the bulk validator if its value doesn't fit the expected shape:

* ''url'' — must start with `http://` or `https://`
* ''email'' — must look like `local@domain.tld` (no spaces, no extra `@`)
* ''phone'' — German format: must start with `+49` or `0`, then at least six chars from digits/spaces/`-`/`/`/`(`/`)`

Empty values don't trigger the format error (use a `required` constraint if the field is mandatory). Character-length constraints work too: `min:8` on an email enforces an 8-character minimum.

You can also grab these as ready-made library entries via type-builder's ''Add field'' dropdown or cascade-mode's ''+ Add field from library…'' — the three common-fields `url` / `email` / `phone` ship with the plugin.

!! Multi-ref typeahead (large option sets)

For ref fields with many possible targets, the typeahead UI shows a filterable search input. Selected values render as pills with × removal. Example field def:

```json
{"key":"stakeholders","caption":"Stakeholders","icon":"👥","typed":"ref","ref-types":["person","team"],"cardinality":"multi"}
```

The candidate set is `[enlist[person team]] :map:flat[all[shadows+tiddlers]kind.type<currentTiddler>] +[unique[]]` — every instance of `person` or `team` in the wiki. The search input filters by title and caption.

!! Validator interpretation

Open the //validator// tab. Each type heading shows the instance count. A table follows with one row per violation:

* ''Red rows'' — blocking constraints (`required`, `min:N`, `max:N`, `unique`, `unique:wiki`, title mismatch)

If a type has no violations, the table is empty (just the heading + "//No instances//" if applicable).

!! Stream-view in action

Once a type's `kind.stream-fields` is set (e.g. `status assignee due-date`), every instance opened in the story river renders a compact field bar above the body:

```
🧮  🚦 doing  👤 Mirko  📅 23rd May 2026  ✎ popup
```

Clicking a cell pops up the field's editor. Clicking the ✎ toggle switches to inline-edit mode (the editor replaces the cell directly).

</$fill>
</$transclude>
"},"$:/plugins/rimir/kind/doc/faq":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/kind/doc/faq","rdt.order":"5","rdt.plugin-key":"kind","rdt.plugin-name":"kind","rdt.plugin-subtitle":"Lightweight schema engine — one tiddler per type, namespaced","rdt.section":"FAQ","type":"text/vnd.tiddlywiki","text":"<$transclude $tiddler="$:/plugins/rimir/doc-template/templates/page">
<$fill $name="body">

!! Q: Why a new plugin alongside `rimir/typed`?

`typed` (~1600 lines) grew several features that don't pay rent inside TiddlyWiki's bag-of-fields model:

* 3-level slot inheritance (`:0`/`:1`/`:2`) — needs `rrfunc` because native `function[]` leaks; needs `$importvariables` for the parent chain; capped at 3 levels by TW issue #9647
* Separate per-field tiddlers (e.g. ~40 in `orga-data-model`)
* Per-type field overrides via the `validity` field
* Cross-plugin enum tiddlers with their own inheritance
* Two object-ref editor modes (typeahead + pills)

`kind` keeps the spirit (schema-as-tiddlers, JSON-friendly, validator) and drops all of the above. The result is ~50% the code with explicit namespace support added.

!! Q: Why no inheritance?

In real schemas the inheritance was mostly used for one thing: a shared base (`_node`) defining common fields like `title`, `caption`, `description`, `parent`. With flat schemas you copy those 4-5 fields into every type tiddler. That's <50 lines of JSON duplication across a 10-type domain model — cheap, especially when the type-builder makes copy-paste easy. The override pattern (subtype dropping a base field via `:0`) was clever but rare and often a smell. And `[has[kind.type]]` already gives you an "all instances" filter without needing a base type.

!! Q: How do I share fields across types?

You don't, structurally. You copy the field def into each type's `kind.fields` JSON. That's the price of KISS. If you find yourself maintaining the same 10-field block across 8 types, you can extract a shared `kind.fields` value into a config tiddler and reference it — but for v0.1.0 that's manual.

!! Q: How do I migrate from `rimir/typed`?

Both plugins can coexist (different field namespaces: `rrt.*` vs `kind.*`, different instance markers). To migrate one type at a time:

# Read the typed type tiddler's `rrt.fields:0()`, `:1()`, `:2()` body
# Look up each field's def in the corresponding `*-data-model` plugin
# Compose a single `kind.fields` JSON array with the union
# Move `validity`-restricted overrides into the relevant subtype's JSON directly
# Update instance tiddlers from `rrt.type: X` to `kind.type: X` (one-line `$:/state/...` action filter)

After migrating all types, you can remove the typed plugin.

!! Q: What if I want a field type that's not in the list?

Add it. Open `field-input.tid`, find the `<%elseif [<field-typed>match[X]]%>` cascade, add a new branch. Whatever wikitext renders an editable widget. The constraint and validation logic in `engine.tid` already covers the generic cases (required/min/max/unique); add a `kind.viol-<name>` function if your new type needs new constraints.

!! Q: Why JSON for the field array instead of separate field tiddlers?

The JSON-in-one-field approach trades reusability for locality. The whole schema for one type is in one tiddler — open it, see everything. With separate field tiddlers you'd be reading two or three tiddlers in parallel to understand a type. For the volume most users hit (single-digit types per namespace, 5-15 fields per type), locality wins.

The `kind.fields` field stores stringified-JSON because storing as a `application/json` body would force the type tiddler to be saved as `.json + .json.meta` (two files), which breaks the convention of one-tiddler-per-file. The body stays free for prose documentation of the type.

!! Q: Why aren't multi-value uniqueness checks set-aware?

`unique` and `unique:wiki` use exact string equality on the whole field value. For multi-value refs/enums where order doesn't semantically matter (e.g. `assignee: "alice bob"` vs `assignee: "bob alice"`), this means a logical-duplicate isn't flagged. Fixing this properly would require value normalization (sort + dedupe before comparison) and a stronger uniqueness predicate. Planned for v0.2 if needed.

</$fill>
</$transclude>
"},"$:/plugins/rimir/kind/doc/overview":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/kind/doc/overview","rdt.hub-category":"ui-framework","rdt.hub-category-name":"UI Framework & Domain Model","rdt.hub-order":"4","rdt.order":"1","rdt.plugin-key":"kind","rdt.plugin-name":"kind","rdt.plugin-subtitle":"Lightweight schema engine — one tiddler per type, namespaced","rdt.section":"Overview","type":"text/vnd.tiddlywiki","text":"<$transclude $tiddler="$:/plugins/rimir/doc-template/templates/page">
<$fill $name="body">

!! What it does

''kind'' is a lightweight schema engine for TiddlyWiki. Each type's full definition — fields, constraints, title formula, icon, namespace memberships, and stream-river display config — lives on a single tiddler. Instances are plain tiddlers marked with a `kind.type` field. No inheritance, no separate per-field tiddlers, no central registry.

!! Features

* ''Schema-as-tiddler'' — one tiddler per type, with field defs as a JSON array in `kind.fields`
* ''Discovery'' — `[all[shadows+tiddlers]has[kind.type]has[kind.fields]]` finds all type tiddlers
* ''Namespaces'' — types declare `kind.namespaces`, the active scope picks one (or all)
* ''Editor'' — 2-column form (label + input), table-style, with live validation messages
* ''Field Bar'' — auto-rendered in the stream river on every instance; configurable per type; self-disabling
* ''Creator'' — pick a type, fill fields, click Create; title computed from `kind.title-formula`
* ''Validator'' — wiki-wide report of constraint violations
* ''Type-builder'' — structured editor for type metadata + JSON textarea for fields, with live preview
* ''Cascade-palette integration'' (soft-dep) — when `rimir/cascade-palette` is installed, kind contributes ''Find by kind'', ''Find entity'', ''Create entity'', and ''Manage kinds'' root entries to the palette. The leader key ''`k`'' jumps straight into the ''Manage kinds'' drill. ''Manage kinds'' is the cascade-mode equivalent of the Type-builder tab: ''+ Create new kind…'' at the root captures a type-key and creates a stub tiddler with the type-builder's defaults; ''+ Clone existing kind…'' picks a source kind, then a text-input row captures the new type-key and clones the schema (`kind.fields` / `kind.title-formula` / `kind.stream-fields` / `kind.namespaces` copied; `kind.type` / `kind.caption` / `kind.icon` blank for the user to set). Drill into an existing kind to edit metadata (caption / icon / namespaces / title-formula / stream-fields), drill into one of its fields to rename the field key (with `kind.stream-fields` auto-sync; instance values stay under the old key) / set typed / caption / icon / cardinality / constraints (toggles for required / unique / unique:wiki; text-edit rows for min:N / max:N; +Add custom constraint…) / options / ref-types via picker sub-stages, ''+ Add field from library…'' picks from common-field defs, ''+ Add new field…'' captures a new field key and creates a row with `typed: text` so it is immediately editable (drill in to change typed / caption / constraints), DEL on a field row removes it with a confirm step, ''DEL on a kind row'' (Manage kinds top-level) removes the kind with a confirm step whose consequence text spells out how many instances would be orphaned (same as the in-drill `🗑 Delete this kind` leaf), ''Ctrl-↑ / Ctrl-↓'' reorder the focused field within `kind.fields` (the array order IS the form field order, so the move propagates to instances created after). Adding a field (either path) auto-appends the key to `kind.stream-fields` (idempotent); deleting a field also removes its key from that list. ''Live create-form preview'' — while drilled into a kind's schema, the palette splits 50/50 and the right pane renders the create-instance form (the same one ''Create entity'' shows) against a per-kind preview-draft tiddler; the form re-renders as the user edits the schema so the effect of every field change is immediately visible. ''Create entity'' opens a draft form with one row per editable field, an optional ''📋 Clone fields from existing <kind>'' drill that picks a source instance and copies its field values into the draft (computed fields and `kind.fields[].clone: skip` excluded), and a ''Save'' leaf whose name previews the computed title (e.g. `💾 Save as "test"`) or swaps to a ''⛔ Cannot save — title-formula yields empty'' row if the formula resolves to empty — the row swaps live as fields fill. ''Ref-field pickers'' also offer ''+ Create new <X>'' (drills into a nested spawn-create flow with its own Save / Clone / field-edit + Cancel via Esc; on Save the new instance is materialised AND linked into the parent's ref field; pops back to the picker with the new ref selected, supports arbitrary nesting depth via the same cascade stack) alongside the existing candidate list. Find by kind / Find entity drill kind → instance lists, with a ''live instance preview'' in the side-preview pane — auto-attached via the cascade-palette tag ''`$:/tags/rimir/cascade-palette/side-preview`'' on `palette/preview/instance-view`. The preview's `ca-preview-applies` filter (`[<currentTiddler>has[kind.type]]`) matches any kind-instance row, so ↑/↓ across results updates the read-only card view live. The same preview also auto-attaches during ''+ New <Kind>'' (anchored to the draft tiddler — every field commit on the left re-renders the card on the right) and during the ''Edit fields'' action (anchored to the entity being modified).

!! Schema model

* ''Type tiddlers'' — fields `kind.type` (the key), `kind.caption`, `kind.icon`, `kind.namespaces`, `kind.title-formula`, `kind.stream-fields`, and `kind.fields` (JSON array)
* ''Field defs'' — entries inside the JSON array with `key`, `typed`, `caption`, `icon`, `constraints`, `options` (enum), `ref-types` + `cardinality` (ref)
* ''Instance tiddlers'' — any tiddler with `kind.type: <type-key>` is an instance

!! Prerequisites

TiddlyWiki ≥ 5.4.0 in Node.js server mode. No other plugin dependencies. Optional: `$:/plugins/rimir/doc-template` for the documentation hub you're reading right now.

!! Quick start

# Open the ''type-builder'' tab; create a blank type and fill its metadata
# Paste a field-list JSON (see the Examples section)
# Open the ''creator'' tab, pick the type, fill the fields, click Create
# Open the resulting tiddler in the story river — the field bar appears at the top
# Use the ''validator'' tab to scan the whole wiki for constraint violations

<$transclude $tiddler="$:/plugins/rimir/doc-template/templates/callout" type="info">
<$fill $name="body">''Why a new plugin alongside `rimir/typed`?'' typed has accumulated features (3-level inheritance, separate per-field tiddlers, two ref-editor modes, ~1600 lines). kind drops everything that doesn't pay rent in TiddlyWiki's bag-of-fields model and adds namespaces. See the FAQ for details.</$fill>
</$transclude>

</$fill>
</$transclude>
"},"$:/plugins/rimir/kind/doc/reference":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/kind/doc/reference","rdt.order":"6","rdt.plugin-key":"kind","rdt.plugin-name":"kind","rdt.plugin-subtitle":"Lightweight schema engine — one tiddler per type, namespaced","rdt.section":"Reference","type":"text/vnd.tiddlywiki","text":"<$transclude $tiddler="$:/plugins/rimir/doc-template/templates/page">
<$fill $name="body">

!! Type tiddler fields

|!Field |!Required |!Description |
|`kind.type` |Yes |Unique type key. Instances of this type carry `kind.type: <this-value>`. |
|`kind.fields` |Yes |Stringified-JSON array of field definitions. See //Field def schema// below. |
|`kind.caption` |No |Display name shown in dropdowns, validator headings, etc. |
|`kind.icon` |No |Emoji or short text shown alongside the caption |
|`kind.namespaces` |No |Space-separated namespace memberships. Empty = visible only when active namespace is //(all)//. |
|`kind.title-formula` |No |TW filter expression evaluated with `<target-tid>` as the source. Result becomes the new instance's title. Omit for manually-titled types. |
|`kind.stream-fields` |No |Space-separated field keys shown in the stream-river field bar. Empty / missing = bar is invisible for instances of this type. |

!! Instance tiddler fields

|!Field |!Required |!Description |
|`kind.type` |Yes |The type key. Marks the tiddler as an instance. |
|Field keys from `kind.fields` |Per field's `constraints` |Each field's value is stored as a tiddler field with the name `<key>`. Multi-cardinality values are stored as space-separated lists (TW list-field convention). |

!! Field def schema (entries inside `kind.fields` JSON)

|!Property |!Required |!Description |!Applies to `typed` |
|`key` |Yes |Field key. Used as both the field name on instances and the identifier in `kind.stream-fields` / `kind.title-formula`. |all |
|`typed` |Yes |Editor kind. See //typed values// table. |all |
|`caption` |No |Display label. Falls back to `key` if absent. |all |
|`icon` |No |Emoji or short text. |all |
|`constraints` |No |Array of constraint strings. See //Constraints// table. |all (most relevant for editable types) |
|`options` |Required for `enum` |Array of option strings. |`enum` |
|`ref-types` |Optional for `ref` |Array of `kind.type` values whose instances may be referenced. When empty or absent, all kind-instances in the wiki are selectable (the type-builder displays //(any kind)//). |`ref` |

<$fill $name="body">

!! JSON-in-field via `jsonget` / `jsonindexes`

The whole field-array lives in `kind.fields` as a stringified JSON. Read it with:

```
[<type-tid>get[kind.fields]]                       ← the JSON text
[<type-tid>get[kind.fields]jsonindexes[]]          ← top-level array indices "0","1",…
[<type-tid>get[kind.fields]jsonget<idx>,[key]]     ← scalar at path [idx].key
[<type-tid>get[kind.fields]jsonindexes<idx>,[constraints]]  ← inner-array indices for constraints
[<type-tid>get[kind.fields]jsonget<idx>,[constraints],<c-idx>]  ← one constraint string
```

The engine uses `multi-arg jsonget` (the form with comma-separated path arguments) consistently — chaining single-arg `jsonget` calls inside `:map` is a known TW gotcha that returns empty. See `[[tw-gotchas-filters#jsonget chained inside :map`]].

!! Discovery via `kind.type` + `kind.fields`

`[has[kind.type]has[kind.fields]]` finds tiddlers that look like type definitions — they need both fields. The `kind.fields` requirement filters out instance tiddlers (which have `kind.type` but no `kind.fields`).

`all[shadows+tiddlers]` is implicit in `engine.tid`'s `kind.types-all`; plugin-bundled types ARE shadows.

!! ViewTemplate auto-registration

`viewtemplate.tid` is tagged `$:/tags/ViewTemplate` with `list-after: $:/core/ui/ViewTemplate/title`. TiddlyWiki's ViewTemplate cascade renders all matching templates in order; ours runs right after the title, so the field bar appears at the very top of the body.

The `<%if [<currentTiddler>has[kind.type]] %>` guard means the template is silently a no-op for non-instance tiddlers.

!! Title-formula evaluation pattern

`kind.eval-title` mirrors the pattern from `rimir/typed`:

```
\function kind.eval-title(type-tid, target-tid)
  [<type-tid>get[kind.title-formula]]   ← gets the filter STRING
  :map[<target-tid>subfilter<currentTiddler>]   ← runs filter against target
```

The `<target-tid>subfilter<currentTiddler>` form makes `<target-tid>` the input source to the filter, and `<currentTiddler>` (the formula string from the outer map iteration) supplies the filter string to run.

''Formula authoring note'': each top-level run inside the formula starts with the subfilter source (the target instance). So write `[get[parent]]` (operates on source) NOT `[<currentTiddler>get[parent]]` (would override the source with the OUTER renderer's currentTiddler). The first form gets the target's parent; the second gets whatever tiddler is currently rendering the validator/creator UI — almost never what you want.

!! Live + bulk validation sharing predicates

Both `field-input.tid` (editor) and `validator.tid` (bulk) use the same `kind.viol-*` functions from `engine.tid`. The same constraint logic gives identical results in both surfaces, avoiding the typed-plugin trap where editor and validator drift apart over time.

The predicates are filter functions, so they participate in `:filter` / `<%if%>` predicates naturally and don't require JS.

!! Why no `rrfunc`

`rrfunc` exists in `rimir/typed` to defend against the inheritance slot pattern: `rrt.fields:1()` and `:2()` may legitimately not exist on a base type, and native `function[]` would leak input titles in that case. With flat schemas (no slot pattern), every function we call is guaranteed to be defined — native `function[]` is safe. `kind` ships zero JS modules in v0.1.0.

!! Restricted-wiki considerations

There are none. `kind` doesn't touch the `rimir/llm-connect` restricted-wiki sandbox; tools running in that sandbox can read instances via the standard `get` filter operator, but the kind editor/creator/validator UIs are not meant to render inside a restricted-wiki tool execution. If a future use case needs that, the editor would need to be self-contained (no `\import`) — see `[[tw-gotchas-plugin-quirks#`rimir/llm-connect` restricted wiki blocks `\import`]]`.

!! TW 5.4.0 compatibility

Variables avoid colon-named identifiers (which 5.4.0 parses as dynamic-arg macro calls — see `[[tw-gotchas-540-migration#`<<name:value>>` parses as macro dynamic arg]]`). Config tiddlers omit `type: text/plain` to avoid the filesystem-adapter's `.txt + .txt.meta` split (see `[[feedback-tid-vs-txt-meta]]`).

</$fill>
</$transclude>

\import $:/plugins/rimir/kind/engine

<!-- 2-column editor for any typed instance.
     Required vars in scope:
       target-tid — tiddler to edit (may not exist yet)
     Optional:
       type-key   — fallback when the target tiddler doesn't yet carry kind.type
                    (creator passes this so the editor can render against an unborn draft)
-->

<$let

>
<%if [<type-key>is[blank]] %>
<div class="kind-err">target tiddler has no <code>kind.type</code> field</div>
<%else%>
<$let
  type-tid={{{ [function[kind.locate-type],<type-key>] }}}
>
<%if [<type-tid>is[blank]] %>
<div class="kind-err">no type definition found for kind.type="<<type-key>>"</div>
<%else%>
<table class="kind-editor">
<$list filter="[function[kind.field-keys],<type-tid>]" variable="field-key">
<%if [function[kind.is-computed-typed],<type-tid>,<field-key>!is[blank]] %>
<!-- skip $title and $calculated; they render in view, not editor -->
<%else%>
<tr>
<th class="kind-editor-label">
<$text text={{{ [function[kind.field-icon],<type-tid>,<field-key>] }}}/>
 <$text text={{{ [function[kind.field-caption],<type-tid>,<field-key>] }}}/>
</th>
<td class="kind-editor-value">

</td>
</tr>
<%endif%>
</$list>
</table>
<%endif%>
</$let>
<%endif%>
</$let>

\procedure kind.apply-defaults-to(type-tid, target-tid)
<!-- Walks the type's fields and writes each field's `default` (with %TODAY% / %NOW%
     token expansion) onto the target tiddler — only for fields that are currently
     blank. Idempotent: existing non-blank field values are preserved.
     Also stamps `kind.type` on the target so the draft is a recognisable kind-
     instance for downstream consumers (e.g. the side-preview's instance-view
     template, which gates on `kind.type !is[blank]`). The downstream save path
     overwrites `kind.type` explicitly with the same value, so this is harmless.
     Tokens expand to TW canonical 17-char date format so date/datetime fields
     stay readable by $edit-date and format:date[] (display formatting is done
     by the view layer — kind uses DD.MM.YYYY / DD.MM.YYYY HH:mm). -->
<$action-setfield $tiddler=<<target-tid>> kind.type={{{ [<type-tid>get[kind.type]] }}}/>
<$let _today=<<now "YYYY0MM0DD000000000">> _nowts=<<now "YYYY0MM0DD0hh0mm0ss0XXX">>>
<$list filter="[function[kind.field-keys],<type-tid>]" variable="field-key">
<$let raw-default={{{ [function[kind.field-default],<type-tid>,<field-key>] }}}>
<$list filter="[<raw-default>!is[blank]] :filter[<target-tid>!has<field-key>] +[first[]]" variable="_">
<$action-setfield $tiddler=<<target-tid>> $field=<<field-key>> $value={{{ [<raw-default>search-replace[%TODAY%],<_today>search-replace[%NOW%],<_nowts>] }}}/>
</$list>
</$let>
</$list>
</$let>
\end

\procedure kind.force-apply-defaults(type-tid, target-tid)
<!-- Like kind.apply-defaults-to but unconditional: writes every default-bearing
     field onto target-tid regardless of current state. Used by the Reset row
     where the caller has just deleted target-tid (so "preserve existing values"
     would be incorrect — we WANT to overwrite, and the deletetiddler runs in
     the same action chain as this transclude). The `:filter[!has<field>]` gate
     used in apply-defaults-to evaluates AT RENDER TIME against the pre-delete
     state, which made reset toggle between "all defaults" and "empty" on repeat
     clicks. Dropping the gate makes the action idempotent across clicks.
     Also stamps `kind.type` so the freshly-deleted draft is recognised as a
     kind-instance by the side-preview after Reset. -->
<$action-setfield $tiddler=<<target-tid>> kind.type={{{ [<type-tid>get[kind.type]] }}}/>
<$let _today=<<now "YYYY0MM0DD000000000">> _nowts=<<now "YYYY0MM0DD0hh0mm0ss0XXX">>>
<$list filter="[function[kind.field-keys],<type-tid>]" variable="field-key">
<$let raw-default={{{ [function[kind.field-default],<type-tid>,<field-key>] }}}>
<$list filter="[<raw-default>!is[blank]]" variable="_">
<$action-setfield $tiddler=<<target-tid>> $field=<<field-key>> $value={{{ [<raw-default>search-replace[%TODAY%],<_today>search-replace[%NOW%],<_nowts>] }}}/>
</$list>
</$let>
</$list>
</$let>
\end

\import $:/plugins/rimir/kind/engine

<!-- Per-field input dispatcher.
     Required vars in scope (via $let from caller):
       type-tid     — type definition tiddler
       type-key     — type's kind.type value
       target-tid   — instance tiddler being edited
       field-key    — the field being edited
     Optional:
       inline       — if "yes", suppress validation messages (popup mode shows them; inline mode is terse)
-->

<$let
  field-typed={{{[function[kind.field-typed],<type-tid>,<field-key>]}}}
  field-card={{{[function[kind.field-cardinality],<type-tid>,<field-key>]}}}
>

<%if [<field-typed>match[$title]] [<field-typed>match[$calculated]] +[first[]] %>
<!-- read-only computed; rendered elsewhere -->

<%elseif [<field-typed>match[longtext]] %>
<$edit-text tiddler=<<target-tid>> field=<<field-key>> tag="textarea" class="kind-input kind-textarea"/>

<%elseif [<field-typed>match[number]] %>
<$edit-text tiddler=<<target-tid>> field=<<field-key>> type="number" tag="input" class="kind-input"/>

<%elseif [<field-typed>match[date]] %>
<$edit-date tiddler=<<target-tid>> field=<<field-key>>/>

<%elseif [<field-typed>match[datetime]] %>
<$edit-date tiddler=<<target-tid>> field=<<field-key>> showTime="yes" use24hour="yes"/>

<%elseif [<field-typed>match[url]] %>
<$edit-text tiddler=<<target-tid>> field=<<field-key>> type="url" tag="input" class="kind-input" placeholder="https://…"/>

<%elseif [<field-typed>match[email]] %>
<$edit-text tiddler=<<target-tid>> field=<<field-key>> type="email" tag="input" class="kind-input" placeholder="name@example.com"/>

<%elseif [<field-typed>match[phone]] %>
<$edit-text tiddler=<<target-tid>> field=<<field-key>> type="tel" tag="input" class="kind-input" placeholder="+49 30 12345678"/>

<%elseif [<field-typed>match[enum]] %>
<%if [<field-card>match[multi]] %>
<div class="kind-pill-row">
<$list filter="[function[kind.options],<type-tid>,<field-key>]" variable="opt">
<$let active={{{[<target-tid>get<field-key>enlist-input[]match<opt>limit[1]]}}}>
<$button class={{{[<active>!is[blank]then[kind-pill kind-pill-on]] ~[kind-pill]}}}>
<$action-listops $tiddler=<<target-tid>> $field=<<field-key>> $subfilter="+[toggle<opt>]"/>
<<opt>>
</$button>
</$let>
</$list>
</div>
<%else%>
<$select tiddler=<<target-tid>> field=<<field-key>> class="kind-input">
<option value=""></option>
<$list filter="[function[kind.options],<type-tid>,<field-key>]" variable="opt">
<option value=<<opt>>><<opt>></option>
</$list>
</$select>
<%endif%>

<%elseif [<field-typed>match[ref]] %>
<$let
  search-state={{{ [[$:/state/rimir/kind/ta/]addsuffix<target-tid>addsuffix[/]addsuffix<field-key>] }}}
  is-multi={{{ [<field-card>match[multi]] }}}
  cur={{{ [<target-tid>get<field-key>] }}}
>
<%if [<is-multi>!is[blank]] %>
<!-- multi-ref: show selected pills above search input -->
<div class="kind-pill-row">
<$list filter="[<cur>enlist-input[]]" variable="sel">
<span class="kind-pill kind-pill-on">
<$text text={{{ [function[kind.resolve-ref],<sel>] }}}/>
<$button class="kind-pill-x" tooltip="remove">
<$action-listops $tiddler=<<target-tid>> $field=<<field-key>> $subfilter="+[remove<sel>]"/>
×
</$button>
</span>
</$list>
</div>
<%else%>
<!-- single-ref: show current selection as one pill, or input if blank -->
<%if [<cur>!is[blank]] %>
<span class="kind-pill kind-pill-on">
<$text text={{{ [function[kind.resolve-ref],<cur>] }}}/>
<$button class="kind-pill-x" tooltip="clear">
<$action-setfield $tiddler=<<target-tid>> $field=<<field-key>> $value=""/>
×
</$button>
</span>
<%endif%>
<%endif%>

<!-- search input (always available for multi; only when empty for single) -->
<%if [<is-multi>!is[blank]] [<cur>is[blank]] %>
<$edit-text tiddler=<<search-state>> field="text" tag="input" placeholder="search…" class="kind-input"/>
<$let search-val={{{ [<search-state>get[text]] }}}>
<%if [<search-val>!is[blank]] %>
<div class="kind-dropdown">
<$list filter="[function[kind.ref-candidates],<type-tid>,<field-key>] :filter[search:caption,title<search-val>] +[limit[10]]" variable="opt" emptyMessage="<div class='kind-dropdown-empty'>no matches</div>">
<$button class="kind-dropdown-item tc-btn-invisible">
<%if [<is-multi>!is[blank]] %>
<$action-listops $tiddler=<<target-tid>> $field=<<field-key>> $subfilter="+[toggle<opt>]"/>
<%else%>
<$action-setfield $tiddler=<<target-tid>> $field=<<field-key>> $value=<<opt>>/>
<%endif%>
<$action-deletetiddler $tiddler=<<search-state>>/>
<$text text={{{ [function[kind.resolve-ref],<opt>] }}}/>
</$button>
</$list>
</div>
<%endif%>
</$let>
<%endif%>
</$let>

<%elseif [<field-typed>match[text]] %>
<%if [<field-card>match[multi]] %>
<!-- text + cardinality=multi: pill row over enlist-input[] with ×-remove,
     plus an add-input that appends via $action-listops on Enter.
     Storage is TW list-format ([[Echo Fox]] Foo) — listops auto-quotes
     space-containing entries; enlist-input[] unwraps on read. -->
<$let add-state={{{ [[$:/state/rimir/kind/tm/]addsuffix<target-tid>addsuffix[/]addsuffix<field-key>] }}}>
<div class="kind-pill-row">
<$list filter="[<target-tid>get<field-key>enlist-input[]]" variable="item">
<span class="kind-pill kind-pill-on">
<<item>>
<$button class="kind-pill-x" tooltip="remove">
<$action-listops $tiddler=<<target-tid>> $field=<<field-key>> $subfilter="-[<item>]"/>
×
</$button>
</span>
</$list>
</div>
<$keyboard key="Enter" tag="div" class="kind-tm-add">
<$edit-text tiddler=<<add-state>> field="text" tag="input" placeholder="add value…" class="kind-input"/>
<$list filter="[<add-state>get[text]trim[]!is[blank]]" variable="newVal">
<$action-listops $tiddler=<<target-tid>> $field=<<field-key>> $subfilter="[<newVal>]"/>
<$action-deletetiddler $tiddler=<<add-state>>/>
</$list>
</$keyboard>
</$let>
<%else%>
<$edit-text tiddler=<<target-tid>> field=<<field-key>> tag="input" class="kind-input"/>
<%endif%>

<%else%>
<!-- default: single-line text (fallback for unknown typed values) -->
<$edit-text tiddler=<<target-tid>> field=<<field-key>> tag="input" class="kind-input"/>
<%endif%>

<!-- validation messages (suppressed in inline mode for terseness) -->
<%if [<inline>!match[yes]] %>
<%if [function[kind.viol-required],<type-tid>,<field-key>,<target-tid>] %><div class="kind-err">⛔ required</div><%endif%>
<%if [function[kind.viol-min],<type-tid>,<field-key>,<target-tid>] %><div class="kind-err">⛔ min <$text text={{{ [function[kind.constraint-num],<type-tid>,<field-key>,[min:]] }}}/></div><%endif%>
<%if [function[kind.viol-max],<type-tid>,<field-key>,<target-tid>] %><div class="kind-err">⛔ max <$text text={{{ [function[kind.constraint-num],<type-tid>,<field-key>,[max:]] }}}/></div><%endif%>
<%if [function[kind.viol-unique],<type-tid>,<type-key>,<field-key>,<target-tid>] %><div class="kind-err">⛔ value already used in this type</div><%endif%>
<%if [function[kind.viol-unique-wiki],<type-tid>,<field-key>,<target-tid>] %><div class="kind-err">⛔ value already used in this wiki</div><%endif%>
<%if [function[kind.viol-self-dup],<type-tid>,<field-key>,<target-tid>] %><div class="kind-err">⛔ duplicate value within list</div><%endif%>
<%if [function[kind.viol-format-url],<type-tid>,<field-key>,<target-tid>] %><div class="kind-err">⛔ must start with http:// or https://</div><%endif%>
<%if [function[kind.viol-format-email],<type-tid>,<field-key>,<target-tid>] %><div class="kind-err">⛔ not a valid email address</div><%endif%>
<%if [function[kind.viol-format-phone],<type-tid>,<field-key>,<target-tid>] %><div class="kind-err">⛔ not a valid German phone number (start with +49 or 0)</div><%endif%>
<%endif%>

</$let>

"},"$:/plugins/rimir/kind/readme":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/kind/readme","type":"text/vnd.tiddlywiki","text":"! kind

Lightweight schema engine for TiddlyWiki. Define each type's fields, constraints, title formula, and namespace memberships on a single tiddler. Spawn, edit, view, and validate typed instances through hand-rolled UIs with zero plugin dependencies.

!! Key features

* ''One tiddler per type'' — schema lives in fields and a JSON-encoded `kind.fields` array on a single tiddler; body stays free for prose documentation
* ''Namespaces'' — types declare `kind.namespaces` (multi-membership); a namespace switcher scopes what's visible
* ''Auto-computed titles'' — types declare a `kind.title-formula` filter; new instances get their title computed from sibling fields
* ''Live + bulk validation'' — inline errors as you edit, plus a wiki-wide validator report
* ''Typeahead refs'' — filterable text input + dropdown + selected pills with × remove; scales to large option sets
* ''Configurable stream-river view'' — each type chooses which fields appear in its in-river field bar; empty = bar hidden
* ''Hand-rolled UI'' — zero dependency on other rimir plugins (theme/components/typed)
* ''Cascade-palette integration'' — when `rimir/cascade-palette` ≥ 0.0.79 is installed, kind ships a bridge config (`kind.type` as the entity-type field) so any action declaring `ca-entity-type: <X>` automatically surfaces on Space against any tiddler with `kind.type: <X>` in any view. The four bundled instance-actions (Open, Edit fields, Edit kind schema, Delete) also carry `ca-applies: [<currentTiddler>has[kind.type]]`, so they show up on any kind-instance row regardless of its specific type

!! Prerequisites

No external prerequisites. Optional: `$:/plugins/rimir/doc-template` for the branded documentation hub.

!! Quick start

# Open the ''type-builder'' tab and define a new type (key, caption, icon, namespaces, title-formula, fields JSON).
# Open the ''creator'' tab, pick the type, fill the fields, click Create.
# Open the resulting tiddler in the story river — the stream-view field bar appears at the top.
# Use the ''validator'' tab for a wiki-wide constraint scan.
